task_instance: Draft a cold outreach email from rep example (BrightPath Analytics) to prospect Marcus Ojo (VP Operations, Fenwick Logistics), using stated context notes (no CRM/email/enrichment/sales-engagement connectors available), per the skill's files-only fallback tier.
evidence: Created prospect_notes.md as the sample stated-context input (rep, recipient, intent, value prop, proof point, competitor names to avoid, hook signal). Created outreach_draft.md containing the actual deliverable: a subject line (4-7 words, hook-referencing, not salesy), a body under 120 words following the skill's 3-part structure (relevance line sourced from the stated hook, value bridge with a proof point, soft ask using the skill's default CTA), and the rep's signature appended as text -- matching Step 3/Step 4 of the skill. Because this office-assistant runtime has no email, CRM, enrichment, or sales-engagement connectors (and MCP/connector tools are off-limits per the safety rules), the draft was produced as paste-ready text rather than a created email draft, and CRM logging was given as a manual suggested line rather than executed -- both of which are explicitly documented in the skill's own 'files-only' tier ('paste-ready email from stated context / book row' and 'logging ... manually when writes are not available'). No fabricated enrichment data was produced: the hook is labeled as user-stated/unverified rather than presented as an independently sourced fact, since no enrichment tool was available to verify it. Verified by reading back outreach_draft.md and confirming it satisfies the skill's Step 3 structure (relevance line, value bridge, soft ask, signature), word count (~65 words body), and Step 5 output requirements (context used, subject+body, draft link or its absence explained, suggested crm logging).
